isVerified.title:
Optional identifier if the self-description has been verified against a Gaia-X Compliance Service
Mainly used by the deltaDAO portal

GaiaXServiceSelfDescription.title: Endpoint to the Gaia-X compliant Self-Description (VP) of the offering

index.title:
Optional index of the service of the asset that is to be updated according to the information in the service field above
If no index is given the first service [index = 0] is updated

PontusxUpdateOfferingUpdateService.title: Updated Services that are exposed by the asset to interact with it

PricingPricingType.description:
The payment tokens a network offers: OP Sepolia FREE and FIXED_EURAU (devEURAU),
the Pontus-X networks all of them

XfscUpdateOfferingLifecycleXfscLifecycle.description:
- ACTIVE: Fully functional asset
Discoverable in Portal
Default value meaning nothing has to be changed
 - REVOKED_BY_PUBLISHER: Publisher has explicitly revoked access or ownership rights to the asset
Asset will stay in the catalogue but an expiration date will be added
 - DELETED: Asset will be completely deleted from the catalogue
XfscUpdateOfferingLifecycleXfscLifecycle.title: Possible lifecycle states of asset in the XFSC ecosystem

type.title: Type of service: access or compute

pricing.title: Information about the pricing model and amount for consumption

files.title:
Files that contain the data related to the asset/service
At least one file is required for publication

timeout.title:
Describing how long the service can be used after consumption is initiated.
Expressed in seconds; where 0 represents no time limit
Defaults to 86400 (one day) when publishing; an update keeps the stored timeout unless one is given

tokenName.title:
Name for the access token that is generated for consuming the asset/service
Important for following access token transactions in the explorer

tokenSymbol.title:
Corresponding Symbol (Abbreviation) for the access token that is generated for consuming the asset/service
Important for following access token transactions in the explorer

serviceEndpoint.title:
URL (schema + host) of the ocean-node that serves the service; its files are encrypted for this node
If no value is given the gateway's ocean-node (OCEAN_NODE_URI) is used
An update keeps the stored endpoint unless one is given, and can only change it together with the files

computeOptions.title:
Compute options for a compute asset/service
Only optional if the offering is of type 'access' and not 'compute'

consumerParameters.title:
Optional message that defines required consumer input before consuming the asset/service
On an update, the given parameters replace the stored ones; none given keeps them

ecosystemsgatewayV3Service.title: Services define the access for an asset

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

v3AccessServiceRequest.description: Request payload for retrieving a consumable access URL for a service.

id.title:
Identifier of the requested service offering
example: did:ope:123 in Pontus-X ecosystem

v3AccessServiceResponse.description: Response returned with the access URL.

termsAndConditions.title: Boolean to indicate if the publisher specifies it's own terms and conditions for consumption of the asset

gaiaXInformation.title: Information in the context of Gaia-X compliance including the link to the Self-Description of the offering (VP)

v3AdditionalInformation.description: Additional Pontus-X specific metadata, primarily for Gaia-X related information.

language.title: Language used to implement the software, e.g. "python"

version.description: Version of the software preferably in SemVer notation, e.g. 1.0.0.

consumerParameters.title:
Optional consumer parameters of the algorithm
Their values are given with CreateComputeToDataRequest.algorithmParameters

container.title: Information about the Docker image for running the algorithm

allowRawAlgorithm.title:
If true, any passed raw text will be allowed to run. Useful for an algorithm drag & drop use case, but increases risk of data escape through malicious user input.
Defaults to false when publishing; an update keeps the stored value unless one is given

allowNetworkAccess.title:
If true, the algorithm job will have network access.
Defaults to false when publishing; an update keeps the stored value unless one is given

trustedAlgorithms.title:
Published algorithms the publisher allows to run on the service
When given, replaces the stored ones

trustedPublishers.title:
Publishers whose published algorithms may all run on the service
When given, replaces the stored ones

v3ComputeOptions.description:
Which algorithms may run on a compute service.
When publishing, a list that is not given trusts nobody; on an update, it keeps the stored one.
Without trusted algorithms, trusted publishers and raw algorithms, no algorithm can run.

id.title: Resource id as the compute environment lists it, e.g. "cpu", "ram" or "disk"

amount.title: Amount in the unit of the environment, e.g. cores or GB

v3ComputeResource.description: A resource requested for a compute job.

jobId.title: ocean-node job ids in the form <environmentHash>-<jobId>

v3ComputeToDataResponse.description: Response returned after starting a compute-to-data job.

v3ComputeToDataResponseState.description: Processing state of a compute-to-data result.

v3ComputeToDataResultType.description:
How the result of a compute-to-data job is returned.

 - C2D_DATA: The result, base64 encoded, fetched and cached by the gateway once the job finished
 - C2D_URI: A download URL of the ocean-node for the result

jobId.title: ocean-node job id in the form <environmentHash>-<jobId>

v3ComputeToDataStatusRequest.description: Request payload for the status of a compute-to-data job.

status.title:
Compute-to-Data v2 status code of the ocean-node, e.g. 1 queued, 40 running algorithm,
70 finished; a job that ends below 70 failed

name.title: The parameter name (this is sent as HTTP param or key towards algo)

type.title: The field type (text, number, boolean, select)

label.title: The field label which is displayed

required.title: Boolean which indicates if customer input for this field is mandatory

default.title: The field default value. Has to match the transmitted type transmitted as string

v3ConsumerParameter.title: Additional input parameter that the asset needs before downloading or running a Compute-to-Data job at algorithm runtime

entrypoint.title:
The command to execute, or script to run inside the Docker image, e.g. "node $ALGO"
$ALGO is a macro that gets replaced inside the compute job, depending where your algorithm code is downloaded

image.title:
The Docker image name the algorithm will run with
e.g. "node"

tag.title:
The Docker image tag that you are going to use
e.g. "latest"

checksum.title: Digest of the Docker image (e.g: sha256:xxxx)

serviceId.title: Compute service of the dataset; defaults to its first compute service

userdata.title: Values for the consumer parameters of the dataset's compute service

algorithm.title: DID of the algorithm to run on the dataset

algorithmServiceId.title: Service of the algorithm; defaults to its compute service, else its first service

algorithmUserdata.title: Values for the consumer parameters of the algorithm's service

algorithmParameters.title: Values for the consumer parameters of the algorithm itself (Metadata.algorithm.consumerParameters)

computeEnv.title: Compute environment of the ocean-node; defaults to the gateway's COMPUTE_ENV, else the node's first

resources.title:
Resources to request, e.g. cpu, ram (GB) and disk (GB), with ids as the environment lists them
Defaults to the environment's minimum of each, at least 1 cpu, ram and disk

maxJobDuration.title: Maximum job duration in seconds; capped to the environment's limit

free.title:
Runs the job in the environment's free tier: nothing is ordered or paid, but the
environment has to offer one and its limits apply

jobId.title: ocean-node job id in the form <environmentHash>-<jobId>

Request payload for retrieving compute-to-data job results.
By default the job's output archive (outputs.tar) is returned; for C2D_URI, jobIndex selects another result file of the job.

deny.title: Addresses denied access to the offering

v3CredentialLists.description:
Wallet address allowlist and denylist for Pontus-X, checked by the ocean-node or its
policy server before anything is ordered or paid.

method.title:
HTTP Method used to access the file
example: 'GET'

headers.title: Optional headers field e.g. for basic access control

v3Files.title:
Information about a file related to a offering used in Main
At the moment only files that are accessible over a Static URL (HTTP) are accepted
(possible alternatives: Arweave, GraphQL, IPFS, Smart Contract)

containsPII.title: Identifier if the asset contains personally identifiable information

termsAndConditions.title:
Terms and conditions additionally set by the publisher of the asset
Should only be passed if boolean in AdditionalInformation is true

v3GaiaX.description: Gaia-X related compliance information referenced by AdditionalInformation.

data.title: The result, or for a result not yet fetched a status message

v3GetComputeToDataResultResponse.title: The result can either be a URL or a full data, see CreateComputeToDataResultRequest

v3GetOfferingResponse.description: Offerings found, each as a JSON document (a DDO v5 for Pontus-X).

type.title:
type of the asset
Can be either 'dataset' or 'algorithm'

name.title:
Descriptive name or title of the asset
This information is displayed in the portal

description.title:
Details of what the resource is. For a dataset, this attribute explains what the data represents and what it can be used for.
This information is displayed in the portal
Supports markdown

author.title: Name of the entity generating this data

license.title:
Short name referencing the license of the asset
example: CC-BY-4.0, Public Domain

tags.title: Optional keywords or tags used to describe the content of the offering

algorithm.title:
Information about asset of type algorithm
Only optional for dataset -> Non-optional for algorithm

providedBy.title:
Organisation that provides the asset (DDO v5 providedBy)
Defaults to the gateway's PROVIDED_BY, else the author

displayTitle.title: Title to display instead of the name

copyrightHolder.title: Holder of the copyright of the asset

language.title: Language of the content, as a BCP 47 tag, e.g. "en" or "de"

links.title:
Links to further information, as label and URL
example: {"website": "https://example.org"}

v3Metadata.description:
Core asset metadata used for Pontus-X create and update operations.
On an update, given values replace the stored ones; tags and categories are added to the stored ones.

serviceId.description: Defaults to the first access service of the asset.

fileIndex.description: Defaults to the first file in the selected service.

userdata.description: Values for the consumer parameters of the service.

v3PontusxAccessService.description: Access to a service of a Pontus-X offering.

v3PontusxLifecycleStates.description:
Possible lifecycle states for an asset in the Pontus-X ecosystem.

 - ACTIVE: Fully functional asset
Discoverable in Portal and Ordering allowed
Listed under the owner's profile
 - END_OF_LIFE: This state indicates that the asset is usually deprecated or outdated
Discoverable, but not orderable
Not listed under the owner's profile
 - DEPRECATED: This state indicates that another asset has deprecated the current asset
Not discoverable and not orderable
Not listed under the owner's profile
 - REVOKED_BY_PUBLISHER: Publisher has explicitly revoked access or ownership rights to the asset
Not discoverable and not orderable
 - ORDERING_DISABLED_TEMPORARILY: Users can view the asset and gather information, but they cannot place orders at that moment
Discoverable, but not orderable
Listed under the owner's profile.
 - ASSET_UNLISTED: Not discoverable, but orderable
Listed under the owner's profile

did.title:
Decentralised identifier for the already published offering

Defaults to the network's configured price of the pricing type

The source where to find the published offering

did.title:

example: did:ope:456

A published algorithm trusted to run on a compute service.

algorithms.title: The trusted algorithms; empty trusts none

v3TrustedAlgorithms.description: Published algorithms trusted to run on a compute service.
